  "memo":"Recommend clear. R04 holds because the flagged first attempt is on a new account and exceeds the category's approved-amount percentile, but it is Context only. R03 does not hold despite AVS failure because issuing and IP countries match. No Account access, Card, Velocity or Linkage family is present; all other rule conditions are unmet. No household exception is needed, and no earlier outcome settles the order. No check has completed or is required. A legitimate new customer is more plausible than stolen-card use on these facts. With no installments due, repayment intent cannot support an adverse recommendation. FP-2 §6.6(c) requires clear; no next check would change the policy decision."
